cases.name: Patricia Marie Boney
cases.about: Her sister Joanne Zamudio said she and her sister were very close and, "Nothing was more important to her than her kids." Her obituary said she was a homemaker, member of Our Lady of Victories Church and an avid reader.
cases.narrative: He stabbed her more than 17 times while she was laying next to their infant, leaving multiple stab wounds to her chest, back and neck and her infant covered in blood. Her 9 and 11-year-old children found her and called 911. The Prosecutor’s Office said she was covered in blood on the bed alongside her and Martinez’s baby. Her autopsy noted multiple defensive wounds on her arms and hands as well as a four-and-a-half-inch wound that penetrated her heart.
